content.thinking: The issue: `main` is shadowed by the `def main():` function defined later in the file. Let me rename the module import to `mainmod`.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('t_lookup.py').read()
s=s.replace("main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)","mainmod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mainmod)")
s=s.replace("main.parse_addr","mainmod.parse_addr")
open('t_lookup.py','w').write(s)
EOF
cd /app/tmp && timeout 170 python3 t_lookup.py 99
